items.name: Moscow Winter Cubing 2018
items.information: Registration will be closed on December 27th. When we reach 125 competitors it will still be possible to register but we will only accept a registration if a vacant place appears. The registration fee is as follows: * 1-2 events: 200 RUB (around 3.3 USD) * 3 and more events: 300 RUB (around 5 USD) * If you have any guests: +70 RUB Please take note about registration rules.
